title: eapache/go-resiliency retrier
notes: retrier.New(retrier.ConstantBackoff(attempts - 1, 0), nil).Run(job) for each call (nil classifier: every error is retried); an error after the last attempt gives a null value. Between attempts Run makes a time.NewTimer(0) and receives from it: with Go 1.23+ timers an expired timer is delivered at the receive, so nothing waits, but a timer is allocated each time.
